items.source: Implementations may either create new prepared statements or reuse cached instances. Implementations do not need to concern themselves with DriverExceptions that may be thrown from operations they attempt. The ReactiveCqlTemplate class will catch and handle DriverExceptions appropriately.
items.translation: 实现可以创建新的预编译语句，也可以重用缓存的实例。实现无需关心从它们尝试执行的操作中可能抛出的DriverException。ReactiveCqlTemplate类将捕获并适当处理这些DriverException。

items.source: Classes implementing this interface should also implement the CqlProvider interface if it is able to provide the CQL it uses for PreparedStatement creation. This allows for better contextual information in case of exceptions.
items.translation: 实现此接口的类如果能够提供用于创建 `PreparedStatement` 的 CQL，则还应实现CqlProvider接口。这样在发生异常时可以提供更丰富的上下文信息。

items.source: Create a statement in this session. Allows implementations to use PreparedStatements. The ReactiveCqlTemplate will attempt to cache the PreparedStatements for future use without the overhead of re-preparing on the entire cluster.
items.translation: 在本会话中创建一条语句。此功能允许实现使用 `PreparedStatement`。ReactiveCqlTemplate 将尝试缓存这些 `PreparedStatement` 以供将来使用，而无需在整个集群上重新准备它们。

items.source: Create a statement in this session.
items.translation: 请在本次会话中发表声明。

items.source: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - there is no need to catch DriverException that may be thrown in the implementation of this method. The ReactiveCqlTemplate class will handle them.
items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 无需捕获此方法实现中可能抛出的 DriverException，因为 ReactiveCqlTemplate 类会处理它们。

items.source: session - Session to use to create statement, must not be null.
items.translation: session - 用于创建语句的会话，不能为 null。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: One of the two central callback interfaces used by the ReactiveCqlTemplate class. This interface creates a PreparedStatement given a ReactiveSession, provided by the ReactiveCqlTemplate class.
items.translation: 这是ReactiveCqlTemplate类使用的两个核心回调接口之一。该接口在由ReactiveCqlTemplate类提供的ReactiveSession的基础上，创建一个PreparedStatement。
